  • Field Details

    • VANILLA_ACTION_PRIORITY

      static final int VANILLA_ACTION_PRIORITY
      The priority all event handlers that Cyrus uses (except Anti-Cheat) uses. This is 100 above the default to ensure that Driver's logic will typically happen before Cyrus's logic
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • callSyncEventAsync

      @NotNull <E extends IEvent> @NotNull IEventResult<E> callSyncEventAsync(@NotNull @NotNull PreEventData<E> eventContent)
      Triggers an event whereby event handlers are all ran sequentially. It is preferred to use callParallelEventAsync(PreEventData) but this isn't always possible

      E - the event type
      Parameters:
      eventContent - the content to create the events
      Returns:
